_comment: Clayworks LITE — settings.example.json. NOT a drop-in replacement for ~/.claude/settings.json. Pick the blocks you want and merge them into your existing settings.json. The _comment fields are not part of any CC schema; Claude Code tolerates them, but strip them once you're done customizing.
_comment_general: Three example hook blocks are shown below. Each maps to a LITE artifact: UserPromptSubmit feeds the Nudge skill, SessionStart and Stop are the starting points for the heartbeat-concept pattern. See hooks/examples/ for the full per-event contracts.
_comment_install_path: The UserPromptSubmit Nudge block is for the install.sh / install.ps1 path only. If you installed LITE as a plugin (/plugin install clayworks-lite@clayworks-lite), the plugin already registers that hook; adding it here too makes every due alert show up twice.
_comment_chaining: All hooks that match an event run in parallel, not in the order listed, so don't make one hook depend on another's output. If you already have hooks for an event, append new entries to its 'hooks' array; don't replace the array. Hook entries from user, project, and local settings merge rather than override each other. To chain a second UserPromptSubmit hook (e.g. a freshness gate that injects current docs when CC features come up), add another {"type": "command", ...} object next to the Nudge entry; hooks/examples/userpromptsubmit.sh shows the contract.

hooks._comment: Nudge skill consumer (script install only) — surfaces due alerts to Claude on each prompt. run-python.sh finds python3, python, or py -3 and exits silently if none exists. See skills/clayworks-lite-nudge/SKILL.md.

Optional. Copy hooks/examples/sessionstart.sh to ~/.claude/hooks/sessionstart.sh FIRST, then customize; until the file exists this entry shows a hook error at every session start. The starter example surfaces a primer file at ~/agent/session-primer.md and warns about uncommitted git state in cwd, branching on the payload's 'source' field.

Optional. Runs after every Claude response (not at session exit). Copy hooks/examples/stop.sh to ~/.claude/hooks/stop.sh FIRST, then customize. The starter example logs turn ends and shows the gated 24h-trigger pattern for background work (e.g. dream-style memory consolidation). The heartbeat-concept skill describes the broader cadence pattern.

_comment_permissions: Add a top-level 'permissions' block to allowlist common commands and reduce permission prompts. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings for the schema. Claude Code's bundled /fewer-permission-prompts skill can scan recent transcripts and suggest a starter allowlist.
_comment_env: Add a top-level 'env' block for environment variables that should be set when CC runs (project-relevant paths, debug flags, etc.). Strict JSON — string values only. Keep secrets out of this file; load them from your shell's secret store instead.
_comment_plugins: If you install LITE-recommended plugins (Engram for memory, Honcho for user modeling), they manage their own settings.json entries when added via /plugin install. See the LITE README's Acknowledgments for the upstream repos and skills/clayworks-lite-memory-routing/SKILL.md for the marketplace-add commands.
